about.profile_subtitle: Legal information and key business lines of HASC VN.
business_lines: Manufacture and trade PE protective films, PE bags, biodegradable PE films, and biodegradable bags.
Manufacture and trade shrink films for packaged products such as cans, bags, bottles, etc.
Manufacture and supply films and bags tailored to custom packaging dimensions.
Process and assemble carton paper filters and synthetic fiber / fiberglass filter pads for paint booths.
Supply paper industry chemicals including coatings, release agents, polymers, de-inking agents, defoamers, and paper machine cleaning chemicals.

core_statements.title: Vision
core_statements.body: To become a leading expert in the business and production of PE films, biodegradable and conventional packaging films, and paint booth filters in Vietnam, with a global outlook.

core_statements.title: Mission
core_statements.body: Deliver the best products and stable quality and timelines to customers and partners, with the highest level of care.

core_statements.title: Core Values
core_statements.body: Create community value, benefits for shareholders and employees, and opportunities for partners.
